'''Qibbu's Hut''' was a shady [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and hotel in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] entertainment district, owned by [[Qibbu]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. The waitress was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] called [[Laseema]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Kal Skirata]] demanded that Qibbu let him use the top floor of the Hut as a base of operations. Qibbu agreed to do so, to repay a debt of five hundred thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].

==Behind the scenes==
Qibbu's Hut first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' novel ''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'', written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[February 28]], [[2006]]. The cantina was later mentioned in Traviss' sequels to ''Triple Zero'', [[Republic Commando: True Colors|''True Colors'']] and [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']], published on [[October 30]], [[2007]] and [[September 16]], [[2008]], respectively.
